In 2001, on the initiative of Michał Zasada, an organisation was created at Gdansk University of Technology to support foreign exchange among students. Since then, it has been created by people with original ideas, positive energy, and above all, the will to act, which has resulted in numerous successes in the arena of ESN Poland and ESN International, putting us at the forefront of both Polish and European sections. We are the only one in Poland to hold unique projects, such as BaltiC Operation
